ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to 55% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the lateral distal quadrants of both lobes. The central region extending from the peduncle is solid black. Dark mottled clusters and linear streaks are interspersed within the white distal zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees and a deep bounding-box depth relative to the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel amplitudes (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, particularly pronounced on the right lobe medial section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep with concave curvature approaching the median notch and convex curvature at the outer distal margins of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular clusters of high-contrast, textured pixel groups (commensal barnacles) localized on the outer distal tips and margins of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions resembling rake marks visible across the white pigmentation of the right lobe and inner margin of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, distinct from the regular serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, high-contrast circular black spot located in the upper-medial white quadrant of the left lobe.
